title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – price basis 2027 and term proposals
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost picture.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We attach three packages without an index clause. Two offer you a 24- or 36-month commitment at the full 94,800 kg per year, giving you planning security and base load. Is there a cheaper bar variant or delivery pattern that would lower your cost further?

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – price basis 2027 and term proposals
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We welcome your proposal for a 24-month commitment, which allows us to offer a revised base price of €5.31.
For a contract of this duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, as our fixed-price coverage for this material extends only until March 2027.
While recent index drops do not immediately affect our costs due to this coverage, the index clause will ensure future market decreases are passed on to you.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.31 per unit.
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised packages for 1.4404 bar from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We understand from your letter of 6 July that your alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027. You proposed a clause on AS-14404, so one of our three packages includes that clause with a deadband. That shares real movements fairly and keeps your administrative workload low. The other two packages are fixed-price, with a 24- or 36-month commitment at 94,800 kg per year and 60 days payment.

Which of these packages works best for your planning? Could a different bar length or call-off pattern lower your cost further?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised packages for 1.4404 bar from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our offer is a price of €5.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term, so we must include the AS-14404 index clause to support your requested 60-day payment period.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Part 370010 - volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the cost-saving options.

On volume, we can commit to 94,800 kg per year over 24 or 36 months, as set out in the attached packages. Two packages follow your proposal with the AS-14404 clause, a 5% deadband and 60 days payment. The 36-month option gives you a longer secured base load. The third is a fixed-price package at 30 days payment, which eases your cash position.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

We will review the material grade and tolerance options with our engineering team. Could you name the alternative grade you have in mind?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your volume commitment of 94,800 kg per year, which allows us to reduce our price to €5.25 for the 24-month package with 60 days payment and the AS-14404 clause.

To be completely transparent about our current offer, it features a price of €5.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term, so we must decline your third package and proceed with the index-linked options. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please note that our margin and our limits stay internal.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Please note this offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
